description: This file defines the PythonFile class used for representing and processing Python source files in a linter tool. It includes methods for tokenizing, parsing, and analyzing Python source code, as well as handling file contents and import lines.

classes.name: PythonFile
classes.description: Represents a Python source file with methods for tokenization, parsing, and analysis.

classes.name: OmittedLines
classes.description: Handles detection of lines that should be omitted based on 'noqa' comments.

methods.name: Self make(cls, linter_name: str, pc: Path | str | None = None)
methods.description: Factory method to create PythonFile instances from a path or contents.

methods.name: Self with_contents(self, contents: str)
methods.description: Returns a new PythonFile instance with specified contents.

methods.name: str contents(self)
methods.description: Cached property that returns the contents of the file as a string.

methods.name: list[str] lines(self)
methods.description: Returns the source code split into lines.

methods.name: list[TokenInfo] tokens(self)
methods.description: Tokens the file contents and returns a list of token objects.

methods.name: list[list[TokenInfo]] token_lines(self)
methods.description: Segments tokens into lines based on newline tokens.

methods.name: list[list[int]] import_lines(self)
methods.description: Finds line indices where import and from statements occur.

methods.name: int opening_comment_lines(self)
methods.description: Counts the number of comment lines at the top of the file.

methods.name: str docstring(self, start: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the docstring starting after a given token index.

methods.name: dict[int,int] indent_to_dedent(self)
methods.description: Maps indentation points to corresponding dedentation points.

methods.name: list[Sequence[TokenInfo]] braced_sets(self)
methods.description: Returns lists of tokens within braces, filtered by omission.

methods.name: list[TokenInfo] sets(self)
methods.description: Returns tokens that are within 'set' constructs, filtered by omission.

methods.name: int|None insert_import_line(self)
methods.description: Determines line index suitable for inserting an import statement.

methods.name: list[LineWithSets] _lines_with_sets(self)
methods.description: Cached property that constructs LineWithSets objects for each token line.

methods.name: list[Block] blocks(self)
methods.description: Returns Block objects representing code blocks in the source.

methods.name: bool __call__( self, tokens: Sequence[TokenInfo], begin: int = 0, end: int = NO_TOKEN )

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
